newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Colonial says offer closes oversubscribed.
newsitem.headline: Colonial says offer closes oversubscribed.

text.p: Colonial Ltd said on Monday that its public share offer had closed oversubscribed.
The offer was orginally set to close on May 2.
"The board of Colonial has decided to close the public offer now, as the response from the public has been so great," managing director Peter Smedley said in a statement.
"Demand from those who have already applied could not be satisfied to any reasonable extent if the offer were to remain open," Smedley said.
Smedley said this means that the listing date would now be brought forward by one week to May 12. Colonial plans to list on the Australian and New Zealand stock exchanges.
However, Smedley said the offer remained open for existing shareholders until May 2.

Under the public share offer, Colonial issued 153 million shares to the public at a price of A$2.60 per share. Institutions were offered the shares in a price range of A$2.50 to A$2.90 in an open book building tender. The institutional offer was scheduled to close on May 9.
Colonial issued around 422 million shares to policy holders under the group's demutualisation plan.
